description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named ContextMenuCardView, which displays session context information with various UI elements, such as headers, bars, and rows, for a menu interface at the top of a menubar menu.

classes.name: ContextMenuCardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct that displays a context menu card with session details, including session rows, status text, and loading state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ContextMenuCardView with an array of session rows, optional status text, and loading state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout, including conditional rendering based on session data and loading status.

methods.name: subtitle
methods.description: Computes a subtitle string displaying the number of sessions.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Creates a view for an individual session row, including a usage bar and labels.

methods.name: placeholderRow
methods.description: Creates a placeholder view shown when session data is loading.
